name: home-hub-tests
description: 自動測試：Firestore 規則 + 瀏覽器（用 Firebase emulator，唔會掂真資料）

scripts.unit: for f in ../scripts/notify/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.emulated: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore,auth --project demo-fsl "npm run rules && npm run export && npm run e2e"
scripts.test: npm run unit && npm run emulated
